Items.description: The repeatable list of enrollment records for courses inside the Learning Plan

User ID.description: The ID of the enrolled user

Course ID.description: The ID of the enrolled course

Course uid.description: The unique identifier of the course

Course type.description: The type of course (for example, elearning, classroom)

Course begin date.description: The official begin date for the course content

Course end date.description: The official end date for the course content

Enrollment level.description: The user's level in the course enrollment (for example, student, instructor)

Enrollment status.description: The current status of the enrollment (for example, enrolled, completed)

Enrollment created by.description: The ID of the user who performed the enrollment

Enrollment created at.description: The date the enrollment was created

Enrollment validity begin date.description: The date the enrollment validity begins

Enrollment validity end date.description: The date the enrollment validity ends

Enrollment date last updated.description: The last date the enrollment status was updated

Enrollment completion date.description: The date the enrollment status became completed

Enrollment score.description: The score achieved in the course

Enrollment time spent.description: The time spent in the course (in seconds)

Count.description: The number of results in the current page

Has more data.description: Returns true if there are more pages of results

Cursor.description: Cursor string for fetching the next page

Current page size.description: The number of results per page returned

Total page count.description: The total number of pages available

Total count.description: The total number of all matching record

Sort.description: Details about the sorting applied to the results
